title: Memory Items
source: the Hawaiian Airlines A330 PAX FCOM R17 [MEM] procedures

docs.x: EMER DESCENT CREW OXY MASKS ... USE SIGNS ... ON EMER DESCENT ... INITIATE THR LEVERS ... IDLE SPD BRK ... FULL Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-MISC P1/26, ident PRO-ABN-MISC-00012261.0001001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.
docs.r: FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-MISC P1/26 and QRH R35 22.02A

docs.x: STALL RECOVERY NOSE DOWN PITCH CONTROL ... APPLY BANK ... WINGS LEVEL THRUST ... INCREASE SMOOTHLY AS NEEDED SPEEDBRAKES ... CHECK RETRACTED FLIGHT PATH ... RECOVER SMOOTHLY FLAPS 1 ... SELECT Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-MISC P2/26, ident PRO-ABN-MISC-00013664.0002001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.

STALL WARNING AT LIFTOFF THRUST ... TOGA PITCH ATTITUDE ... 15 ° BANK ... WINGS LEVEL Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-MISC P3/26, ident PRO-ABN-MISC-00013665.0002001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.

UNRELIABLE SPEED INDICATION If the safe conduct of the flight is impacted AP ... OFF A/THR ... OFF FD ... OFF PITCH/THRUST Below THRUST RED ALT ... 15° / TOGA Above THRUST RED ALT and Below FL 100 ... 10° / CLB Above THRUST RED ALT and Above FL 100 ... 5° / CLB FLAPS (if CONF 0(1)(2)(3)) ... MAINTAIN CURRENT CONF FLAPS (if CONF FULL) ... SELECT CONF 3 AND MAINTAIN SPEEDBRAKES ... CHECK RETRACTED L/G ... UP When at or above MSA or Circuit Altitude: Level off for troubleshooting Memory items per QRH R35 23.03A, ident ABN-23-A-00017854.0001001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.

LOSS OF BRAKING If no braking: REV ... MAX BRAKE PEDALS ... RELEASE A/SKID OFF ... ORDER A/SKID & N/W STRG ... OFF BRAKE PEDALS ... PRESS MAX BRK PR ... 1000 PSI If still no braking: PARK BRAKE ... USE Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-BRAKES P 1/16, ident PRO-ABN-BRAKES-00010803.0001001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.

TAWS CAUTION "TERRAIN TERRAIN" - "TOO LOW TERRAIN" - "TERRAIN AHEAD" - "CAUTION TERRAIN" - "OBSTACLE AHEAD" - "CAUTION OBSTACLE" During night or IMC conditions: Simultaneously: AP ... OFF PITCH ... PULL UP THRUST LEVERS ... TOGA SPEED BRAKE LEVER ... CHECK RETRACTED BANK ... WINGS LEVEL or ADJUST DO NOT CHANGE CONFIGURATION (SLATS/FLAPS, GEAR) UNTIL CLEAR OF OBSTACLE. During daylight and VMC conditions, with terrain and obstacles clearly in sight: FLIGHT PATH ... ADJUST "SINK RATE" Above 1 000 ft AAL IMC or above 500 ft AAL VMC: FLIGHT PATH ... ADJUST Below 1 000 ft AAL IMC or below 500 ft AAL VMC: GO-AROUND ... CONSIDER "DON’T SINK" FLIGHT PATH ... ADJUST "TOO LOW GEAR" or "TOO LOW FLAPS" GO-AROUND ... PERFORM "GLIDESLOPE" Above 1 000 ft AAL IMC or above 500 ft AAL VMC: FLIGHT PATH ... ADJUST When conditions require a deliberate approach below glideslope: G/S MODE ... OFF Below 1 000 ft AAL IMC or below 500 ft AAL VMC: GO-AROUND ... CONSIDER Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-SURV P 1/8 to 2/8, ident PRO-ABN-SURV-AA-00026795.0001001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.

TAWS WARNING If the TAWS triggers one of the PULL UP alerts: Simultaneously: AP ... OFF PITCH ... PULL UP THRUST LEVERS ... TOGA SPEED BRAKE LEVER ... CHECK RETRACTED BANK ... WINGS LEVEL or ADJUST DO NOT CHANGE CONFIGURATION (SLATS/FLAPS, GEAR) UNTIL CLEAR OF OBSTACLE. Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-SURV P 3/8, ident PRO-ABN-SURV-00026799.0001001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.

TCAS CAUTION - TRAFFIC ADVISORY Do not perform a maneuver based on a TA alone. Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-SURV P 3/8, ident PRO-ABN-SURV-00025042.0001001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.

TCAS WARNING - RESOLUTION ADVISORY All RA, except any CLIMB RA during approach in CONF 3 or FULL: AP (if engaged) ... OFF BOTH FDs ... OFF VERTICAL SPEED ... ADJUST or MAINTAIN Any CLIMB RA during approach in CONF 3 or FULL: GO-AROUND ... PERFORM VERTICAL SPEED ... MONITOR ATC ... NOTIFY When the “CLEAR OF CONFLICT” aural alert sounds: ATC ... NOTIFY LATERAL AND VERTICAL GUIDANCE ... ADJUST AP/FD ... AS RQRD Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-SURV P 4/8 to 5/8, ident PRO-ABN-SURV-00011464.0005001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.

WINDSHEAR WARNING - REACTIVE WINDSHEAR At Takeoff: Before V1: If there are significant variations in airspeed, and in airspeed trend below the indicated V1, reject the takeoff. After V1: THR LEVERS ... TOGA REACHING VR ... ROTATE SRS ORDERS ... FOLLOW When airborne, during initial climb, or at landing: THR LEVERS AT TOGA ... SET OR CONFIRM AP (if engaged) ... KEEP ON SRS ORDERS ... FOLLOW DO NOT CHANGE CONFIGURATION (SLATS/FLAPS, GEAR) UNTIL OUT OF WINDSHEAR. CAREFULLY MONITOR FLIGHT PATH AND SPEED. WHEN OUT OF WINDSHEAR, SMOOTHLY RECOVER NORMAL CLIMB. Memory items per FCOM R17 PRO-ABN-SURV P 6/8 to 7/8, ident PRO-ABN-SURV-00012300.0001001. MEMORY ITEMS. Boxed lines recited cold, verbatim.
